vsm2.14:211.1: Evaṃ viditvā ca puna etesveva – Khandhesu ñāṇabhedatthaṃ, kamatotha visesato; Anūnādhikato ceva, upamāto tatheva ca. Daṭṭhabbato dvidhā evaṃ, passantassatthasiddhito; Vinicchayanayo sammā, viññātabbo vibhāvinā.
vsm2.14:211.2: Tattha kamatoti idha uppattikkamo, pahānakkamo, paṭipattikkamo, bhūmikkamo, desanākkamoti bahuvidho kamo.
vsm2.14:211.3: Tattha ‘‘paṭhamaṃ kalalaṃ hoti, kalalā hoti abbuda’’nti (saṃ. ni. 1.235) evamādi uppattikkamo.
vsm2.14:211.4: ‘‘Dassanena pahātabbā dhammā, bhāvanāya pahātabbā dhammā’’ti (dha. sa. tikamātikā 8) evamādi pahānakkamo.
vsm2.14:211.5: ‘‘Sīlavisuddhi, cittavisuddhī’’ti (ma. ni. 1.259; paṭi. ma. 3.41) evamādi paṭipattikkamo.
vsm2.14:211.7: ‘‘Cattāro satipaṭṭhānā, cattāro sammappadhānā’’ti (dī. ni. 3.145) vā, ‘‘dānakathaṃ, sīlakatha’’nti (dī. ni. 1.298) vā evamādi desanākkamo.
vsm2.14:212.1: Tesu idha uppattikkamo tāva na yujjati, kalalādīnaṃ viya khandhānaṃ pubbāpariyavavatthānena anuppattito.
vsm2.14:213.2: Abhedena hi pañcasu khandhesu attagāhapatitaṃ veneyyajanaṃ samūhaghanavinibbhogadassanena attagāhato mocetukāmo bhagavā hitakāmo tassa tassa janassa sukhagahaṇatthaṃ cakkhuādīnampi visayabhūtaṃ oḷārikaṃ paṭhamaṃ rūpakkhandhaṃ desesi.
vsm2.14:213.4: ‘‘Yaṃ vedayati, taṃ sañjānātī’’ti evaṃ vedanāvisayassa ākāragāhikaṃ saññaṃ.
vsm2.14:213.6: Tesaṃ vedanādīnaṃ nissayaṃ adhipatibhūtañca nesaṃ viññāṇanti
vsm2.14:214.2: Ko pana nesaṃ viseso, khandhā tāva avisesato vuttā.
vsm2.14:214.4: Yathāha – ‘‘Pañca ceva vo, bhikkhave, khandhe desessāmi pañcupādānakkhandhe ca, taṃ suṇātha. Katame ca, bhikkhave, pañcakkhandhā, yaṃkiñci, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ…pe… santike vā, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, rūpakkhandho. Yā kāci vedanā…pe… yaṃkiñci viññāṇaṃ…pe… santike vā, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, viññāṇakkhandho. Ime vuccanti, bhikkhave, pañcakkhandhā. Katame ca, bhikkhave, pañcupādānakkhandhā. Yaṃkiñci, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ…pe… santike vā sāsavaṃ upādāniyaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, rūpupādānakkhandho. Yā kāci vedanā…pe… yaṃkiñci viññāṇaṃ…pe… santike vā sāsavaṃ upādāniyaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, viññāṇupādānakkhandho. Ime vuccanti, bhikkhave, pañcupādānakkhandhā’’ti (saṃ. ni. 3.48).
vsm2.14:215.1: Ettha ca yathā vedanādayo anāsavāpi atthi, na evaṃ rūpaṃ.
vsm2.14:215.2: Yasmā panassa rāsaṭṭhena khandhabhāvo yujjati, tasmā khandhesu vuttaṃ.
vsm2.14:215.3: Yasmā rāsaṭṭhena ca sāsavaṭṭhena ca upādānakkhandhabhāvo yujjati, tasmā upādānakkhandhesu vuttaṃ.
vsm2.14:215.4: Vedanādayo pana anāsavāva khandhesu vuttā. Sāsavā upādānakkhandhesu.
vsm2.14:215.5: Upādānakkhandhāti cettha upādānagocarā khandhā upādānakkhandhāti evamattho daṭṭhabbo.
vsm2.14:215.6: Idha pana sabbepete ekajjhaṃ katvā khandhāti adhippetā.
vsm2.14:216.1: Anūnādhikatoti kasmā pana bhagavatā pañceva khandhā vuttā anūnā anadhikāti.
vsm2.14:217.1: Anekappabhedesu hi saṅkhatadhammesu sabhāgavasena saṅgayhamānesu rūpampi rūpasabhāgekasaṅgahavasena eko khandho hoti.
vsm2.14:218.2: Vuttañhetaṃ ‘‘rūpe kho, bhikkhave, sati rūpaṃ upādāya rūpaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti. Vedanāya, saññāya, saṅkhāresu, viññāṇe sati viññāṇaṃ upādāya viññāṇaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’’ti (saṃ. ni. 3.207).
vsm2.14:219.1: Yepi caññe sīlādayo pañca dhammakkhandhā vuttā, tepi saṅkhārakkhandhe pariyāpannattā ettheva avarodhaṃ gacchanti.
vsm2.14:220.1: Upamātoti ettha hi gilānasālupamo rūpupādānakkhandho, gilānupamassa viññāṇupādānakkhandhassa vatthudvārārammaṇavasena nivāsaṭṭhānato.
vsm2.14:220.6: Tathā ‘‘akusalassa kammassa katattā upacitattā vipākaṃ kāyaviññāṇaṃ uppannaṃ hoti dukkhasahagata’’nti (dha. sa. 556).
vsm2.14:222.1: Daṭṭhabbato dvidhāti saṅkhepato vitthārato cāti evaṃ dvidhā daṭṭhabbatopettha vinicchayanayo viññātabbo.
vsm2.14:223.1: Saṅkhepato hi pañcupādānakkhandhā āsīvisūpame (saṃ. ni. 4.238) vuttanayena ukkhittāsikapaccatthikato, bhārasuttavasena (saṃ. ni. 3.22) bhārato, khajjanīyapariyāyavasena (saṃ. ni. 3.79) khādakato, yamakasuttavasena (saṃ. ni. 3.85) aniccadukkhānattasaṅkhatavadhakato daṭṭhabbā.
vsm2.14:224.1: Vitthārato panettha pheṇapiṇḍo viya rūpaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ, parimaddanāsahanato.
vsm2.14:224.6: Visesato ca suḷārampi ajjhattikaṃ rūpaṃ asubhanti daṭṭhabbaṃ.
vsm2.14:225.1: Evaṃ passantassatthasiddhitoti evañca saṅkhepavitthāravasena dvidhā passato yā atthasiddhi hoti, tatopi vinicchayanayo viññātabbo.
vsm2.14:225.2: Seyyathidaṃ – saṅkhepato tāva pañcupādānakkhandhe ukkhittāsikapaccatthikādibhāvena passanto khandhehi na vihaññati.
vsm2.14:225.3: Vitthārato pana rūpādīni pheṇapiṇḍādisadisabhāvena passanto na asāresu sāradassī hoti.
vsm2.14:226.1: Visesato ca ajjhattikarūpaṃ asubhato passanto kabaḷīkārāhāraṃ parijānāti,
vsm2.14:226.3: Kāmoghaṃ uttarati, kāmayogena visaṃyujjati, kāmāsavena anāsavo hoti, abhijjhākāyaganthaṃ bhindati, kāmupādānaṃ na upādiyati.
vsm2.14:227.3: bhavoghaṃ uttarati, bhavayogena visaṃyujjati, bhavāsavena anāsavo hoti, byāpādakāyaganthaṃ bhindati, sīlabbatupādānaṃ na upādiyati.
vsm2.14:228.1: Saññaṃ saṅkhāre ca anattato passanto manosañcetanāhāraṃ parijānāti,
vsm2.14:228.3: diṭṭhoghaṃ uttarati, diṭṭhiyogena visaṃyujjati, diṭṭhāsavena anāsavo hoti.
vsm2.14:229.3: avijjoghaṃ uttarati, avijjāyogena visaṃyujjati, avijjāsavena anāsavo hoti,
vsm2.14:230.1: Evaṃ mahānisaṃsaṃ, vadhakādivasena dassanaṃ yasmā; Tasmā khandhe dhīro, vadhakādivasena passeyyāti.
vsm2.14:230.2: Iti sādhujanapāmojjatthāya kate visuddhimagge Paññābhāvanādhikāre Khandhaniddeso nāma Cuddasamo paricchedo
